rationale: The workflow already implements the two most relevant optimizations: dependency caching via the Poetry virtualenv cache keyed on poetry.lock (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE, contraindicated because an equivalent cache already exists) and stale run cancellation via concurrency with cancel-in-progress: true (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE already present). P-LIT-FAIL-FAST and P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST require a matrix strategy, which this workflow does not use. P-LIT-SELECT and P-LIT-BUILD-SELECT would reduce test coverage, conflicting with the pytest --cov requirement. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT lacks representative duration history for all jobs, especially check-docker-image and check-pyenv (which run only on non-master branches), and risks breaking valid slow runs such as cold Docker builds or pyenv installation. No other pattern applies without weakening coverage or adding unsupported infrastructure.
